slider.label: Surface Ambient Gain
slider.name: ks_ambient_scale
slider.tool_tip: Multiplies ambient fill on surfaces only, so it shows most up close. Does not change the sky, clouds, haze or water. At Probe Fill Strength 1 or more it no longer lights surfaces. Negative values darken lit areas. Loading a graphics preset resets it to 1.

slider.label: Sky Ambient Gain
slider.name: sky_ambient_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of the sky's ambient color, saved with the sky (hue kept). Reaches the sky, clouds, haze and surface fill; water only through reflected sky. Surfaces use its brightness only. At Probe Fill Strength 1 or more it no longer lights surfaces. (KS Reference)

text.name: skyc_ambient_color_label
text.tool_tip: Hue of the sky's ambient color. Sky Ambient Gain sets its brightness. Tints the sky, clouds and haze; surfaces use only its brightness. (KS Reference)

color_swatch.name: skyc_ambient_color
color_swatch.tool_tip: Hue of the sky's ambient color. Sky Ambient Gain sets its brightness. Tints the sky, clouds and haze; surfaces use only its brightness. (KS Reference)

text.name: ks_ro_origin_label
text.tool_tip: EEP sky, or a legacy sky shown through the auto-adjust conversion.

text.name: skyc_sunlight_color_label
text.tool_tip: Light color of both the sun and the moon (color + intensity 0-3). (KS Reference)

color_swatch.name: skyc_sunlight_color
color_swatch.tool_tip: Light color of both the sun and the moon (color + intensity 0-3). (KS Reference)

slider.label: Sunlight Gain
slider.name: ks_sunlight_scale
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of direct sun and moon light.

slider.label: Sun scale
slider.name: sky_sun_scale
slider.tool_tip: Larger discs fade out later at the horizon.

slider.label: Moon scale
slider.name: sky_moon_scale
slider.tool_tip: Larger discs fade out later at the horizon.

slider.label: Moon Disk Brightness
slider.name: sky_moon_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of the moon disc and night glow. Does not change moonlight on surfaces.

check_box.label: Partial moon below horizon
check_box.name: ks_partial_moon
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps the sun and moon discs visible until their upper edges pass below the horizon. Off: the original center-based cutoff.

slider.label: Star brightness
slider.name: sky_star_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of the stars. They are added over the sky, so they show only where the sky is dark. 0 hides them.
